# Bastian Machek / Fokuspunk

> Bastian Machek, known online as Fokuspunk and as bmachek on GitHub, is a photographer and open-source developer in the Landshut area of southern Germany. This is his personal blog and project hub.

## Identity and first-party profiles

- [About Bastian Machek / Fokuspunk](https://blog.fokuspunk.de/about-me/): biography, project roles and profile links.
- [Home and project directory](https://blog.fokuspunk.de/): overview and latest articles.
- [GitHub: bmachek](https://github.com/bmachek): public developer profile.
- [Fokuspunk photography](https://www.fokuspunk.de): photography portfolio.
- [Instagram: fokuspunk](https://www.instagram.com/fokuspunk/): photography profile.
- [Photography gear](https://blog.fokuspunk.de/gear/): camera, lenses and software.
- [Contact](https://blog.fokuspunk.de/contact-me/): email and project support.

## Projects

### MoodSwings — Die Stadt der Flummis
Open-source comedy sandbox by Bastian Machek, written in Rust with Bevy and Avian 3D. Citizens bounce and pass moods to one another through taunts, cheers and collisions. Landshüpf uses Landshut map data; other city styles are procedural. An experimental multiplayer mode supports shared on-foot exploration on a trusted LAN or private VPN. GPL-3.0-or-later. This is a game, not a mood-tracking or health app. As of September 13, 2026, source builds are available but no packaged GitHub releases have been published.
- [MoodSwings project page](https://blog.fokuspunk.de/moodswings/)
- [Source, setup and current development status](https://github.com/bmachek/MoodSwings)

### LrGeniusAI
Bastian Machek is creator and lead developer. Lightroom Classic plugin for AI tagging, descriptions, semantic search, face recognition and on-device species identification. Beta tools include image culling and Develop recipes learned from saved edits. Lua plugin with a Rust backend, SigLIP2 embeddings and LanceDB. Built-in MLX on macOS and llama.cpp on Windows; also Ollama, LM Studio, Gemini and OpenAI. The former Python backend is obsolete and Vertex AI support was removed in August 2026. AGPL-3.0.
- [Project page](https://blog.fokuspunk.de/LrGeniusAI/)
- [Website and help](https://lrgenius.com)
- [Repository and releases](https://github.com/LrGenius/LrGeniusAI)

### Lightroom Immich Plugin
Free Lightroom Classic plugin by Bastian Machek to export, publish, sync albums and import photos between Lightroom and an Immich server. A publish service is a synchronised copy, not a replacement for independent backups of originals and the Lightroom catalog.
- [Project page](https://blog.fokuspunk.de/lrc-immich-plugin/)
- [Repository](https://github.com/bmachek/lrc-immich-plugin)
- [Current setup and permissions](https://github.com/bmachek/lrc-immich-plugin/wiki)

### Lightroom PicPeak Plugin
Initial implementation by Bastian Machek; current project under the PicPeak organisation. Publish client galleries, import proofing ratings and colour labels onto matching RAW files, then replace proofs with finished edits in the same event while retaining feedback.
- [Project page](https://blog.fokuspunk.de/lrc-picpeak/)
- [Current repository](https://github.com/PicPeak/plugin-lightroom)
- [Round-trip documentation](https://docs.picpeak.app/guides/lightroom-roundtrip)

### social-mcp
Self-hosted MCP server by Bastian Machek for Instagram and Facebook Page publishing, scheduling, analytics and photo-inbox planning through Claude. Meta tokens are configured locally and sent to Meta to authenticate requests; selected media is sent to Meta. Self-hosting does not mean no external data processing.
- [Project page](https://blog.fokuspunk.de/social-mcp/)
- [Repository](https://github.com/bmachek/social-mcp)

### CIDP Buddy
App by Bastian Machek, built from his own experience with CIDP, for infusion and medication schedules, supply inventory and a vitals and symptom diary. Flutter targets Android and iOS. GPL v3 license file; consult the repository for current builds and availability.
- [Project page](https://blog.fokuspunk.de/cidp-buddy/)
- [Repository](https://github.com/bmachek/CIDPbuddy)
- [Privacy policy in German](https://blog.fokuspunk.de/cidp-buddy/privacy/)
